headline: Approved appointment of assistant election officials for the November 3rd state general election.
summary: The agenda was adopted unanimously. The consent agenda was adopted unanimously and included a resolution appointing assistant election officials for the November 3rd, State General Election.
decisions: Approved the resolution appointing assistant election officials for the November 3rd, State General Election, as part of the consent agenda, passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Councilor Grant, seconded by Councilor McKnight, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously,
